caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: Attributes defined by the Physical Security extension.
name: dictionary

lifecycle_id.caption: Lifecycle ID
lifecycle_id.description: The normalized lifecycle state of the condition, separating the state transition from the event type. This mirrors the SIA DC-03 second-letter modifier and the Contact ID qualifier field.

1.caption: New
1.description: A new event condition, equivalent to Contact ID qualifier 1.

2.caption: Restore
2.description: The condition returned to normal, equivalent to Contact ID qualifier 3 and the SIA DC-03 second-letter modifier R.

3.caption: Still Present
3.description: A previously reported condition is still present, equivalent to Contact ID qualifier 6.

4.caption: Cancel
4.description: The condition was cancelled by an authorized person.

5.caption: Trouble
5.description: A fault condition affecting the point or device.

6.caption: Trouble Restore
6.description: A fault condition returned to normal.

7.caption: Bypass
7.description: The point was bypassed or shunted.

8.caption: Unbypass
8.description: The point was returned to service.

9.caption: Test
9.description: The event was generated by a test.

lifecycle.caption: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: The lifecycle state, normalized to the caption of the lifecycle_id value.

urgency_id.caption: Urgency ID
urgency_id.description: The time available to take responsive action, using the dimension defined by the Common Alerting Protocol.

1.caption: Immediate
1.description: Responsive action should be taken immediately.

2.caption: Expected
2.description: Responsive action should be taken soon.

3.caption: Future
3.description: Responsive action should be taken in the near future.

4.caption: Past
4.description: Responsive action is no longer required.

urgency.caption: Urgency
urgency.description: The urgency, normalized to the caption of the urgency_id value.

certainty_id.caption: Certainty ID
certainty_id.description: The confidence that the reported condition occurred, using the dimension defined by the Common Alerting Protocol.

1.caption: Observed
1.description: Determined to have occurred or to be ongoing.

3.caption: Possible
3.description: Probability less than or equal to approximately 50 percent.

4.caption: Unlikely
4.description: Not expected to occur, with probability approaching zero.

certainty.caption: Certainty
certainty.description: The certainty, normalized to the caption of the certainty_id value.

response_type_id.caption: Response Type ID
response_type_id.description: The recommended responsive action, using the dimension defined by the Common Alerting Protocol.

7.caption: Assess
7.description: Evaluate the information in this event.

8.caption: All Clear
8.description: The subject event no longer poses a threat.

response_type.caption: Response Type
response_type.description: The response type, normalized to the caption of the response_type_id value.

derivation_id.caption: Derivation ID
derivation_id.description: How the reported condition was determined. Inferred conditions such as tailgating are not directly observable and must declare their derivation.

1.caption: Direct
1.description: Reported directly by a device or person.

2.caption: Sensor Fusion
2.description: Inferred by correlating two or more sensor sources.

4.caption: Count Reconciliation
4.description: Inferred by reconciling grant counts against door contact transitions.

5.caption: Schedule Correlation
5.description: Inferred by correlating against an expected schedule.

derivation.caption: Derivation
derivation.description: The derivation method, normalized to the caption of the derivation_id value.

confidence_pct.caption: Confidence Percentage
confidence_pct.description: The confidence of an inferred determination, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

signal_code.caption: Signal Code
signal_code.description: The equivalent identifiers for this event in established physical security vocabularies.

sia_dc03_code.caption: SIA DC-03 Code
sia_dc03_code.description: The two-character event code defined by the SIA DC-03 format standard.

contact_id_code.caption: Contact ID Code
contact_id_code.description: The three-digit event code defined by the Ademco Contact ID protocol.

contact_id_qualifier.caption: Contact ID Qualifier
contact_id_qualifier.description: The Contact ID qualifier, where 1 indicates a new event, 3 a restore, and 6 a previously reported condition still present.

onvif_topic.caption: ONVIF Topic
onvif_topic.description: The ONVIF topic namespace string for this event.

osdp_reply.caption: OSDP Reply
osdp_reply.description: The OSDP reply name from which this event was derived.

native_type.caption: Native Type
native_type.description: The event type string as emitted by the originating system, retained verbatim.

portal.caption: Portal
portal.description: The door, gate, turnstile, or other controlled opening.

alarm_point.caption: Alarm Point
alarm_point.description: The monitored point that generated the signal.

disposition.caption: Disposition
disposition.description: The validated outcome of the signal.

portal_type_id.caption: Portal Type ID
portal_type_id.description: The normalized type of the controlled opening.

6.caption: Elevator
6.description: An elevator or floor-access control point.

7.caption: Cage
7.description: A cabinet, cage, or rack door.

portal_type.caption: Portal Type
portal_type.description: The portal type, normalized to the caption of the portal_type_id value.

portal_mode.caption: Portal Mode
portal_mode.description: The commanded state of the portal, using the ONVIF door mode vocabulary. Expected values are Locked, Unlocked, Accessed, Blocked, LockedDown, LockedOpen, and DoubleLocked.

portal_physical_state.caption: Portal Physical State
portal_physical_state.description: The observed physical state of the portal, using the ONVIF vocabulary. Expected values are Open, Closed, and Fault.

held_open_duration.caption: Held Open Duration
held_open_duration.description: The time in milliseconds the portal remained open beyond its configured threshold.

credential_type_id.caption: Credential Type ID
credential_type_id.description: The normalized form of the credential presented.

1.caption: Card
1.description: A physical proximity or smart card.

7.caption: Escort
7.description: Entry authorized by an escorting person rather than by a credential.

credential_type.caption: Credential Type
credential_type.description: The credential type, normalized to the caption of the credential_type_id value.

credential_status.caption: Credential Status
credential_status.description: The status of the credential, using the ONVIF credential reason vocabulary. Expected values are LockedOut, Blocked, Lost, Stolen, Damaged, Destroyed, Inactivity, Expired, and RenewalNeeded.

is_antipassback_violated.caption: Antipassback Violated
is_antipassback_violated.description: Indicates the presentation violated an antipassback rule.

zone_type_id.caption: Zone Type ID
zone_type_id.description: The normalized classification of the zone.

1.caption: Perimeter
1.description: The outer boundary of the site.

2.caption: Public
2.description: An area open to the public.

3.caption: Restricted
3.description: An area restricted to authorized persons.

5.caption: Transitional
5.description: A lobby, corridor, or other transitional space.

6.caption: External
6.description: An outdoor area within the site boundary.

zone_type.caption: Zone Type
zone_type.description: The zone type, normalized to the caption of the zone_type_id value.

is_armed.caption: Armed
is_armed.description: Indicates the zone or point was armed at the time of the event.

sensor_type.caption: Sensor Type
sensor_type.description: The detection technology of the monitored point, for example contact, motion, glassbreak, seismic, beam, fence, radar, or lidar.

post_type_id.caption: Post Type ID
post_type_id.description: The normalized type of guard post.

1.caption: Fixed
1.description: A static post at a defined location.

2.caption: Patrol
2.description: A roving post covering an area.

3.caption: Gatehouse
3.description: An access-control post at a vehicle or pedestrian entrance.

4.caption: Console
4.description: A monitoring position in an operations centre.

5.caption: Mobile
5.description: A vehicle-based post covering multiple sites.

6.caption: Remote
6.description: A post staffed from a remote operations centre.

post_type.caption: Post Type
post_type.description: The post type, normalized to the caption of the post_type_id value.

is_billable.caption: Billable
is_billable.description: Indicates the hours associated with this event are billable to the client.

scheduled_start_time.caption: Scheduled Start Time
scheduled_start_time.description: The scheduled start time of the shift or tour.

scheduled_end_time.caption: Scheduled End Time
scheduled_end_time.description: The scheduled end time of the shift or tour.

variance.caption: Variance
variance.description: The signed difference in milliseconds between the scheduled and actual time. A positive value indicates the actual time was later than scheduled.

checkpoint_token_type.caption: Checkpoint Token Type
checkpoint_token_type.description: The physical token technology used to register a checkpoint scan, for example NFC, QR, iButton, BLE, or GPS.

checkpoint_count.caption: Checkpoint Count
checkpoint_count.description: The number of checkpoints registered during the tour.

checkpoint_expected_count.caption: Expected Checkpoint Count
checkpoint_expected_count.description: The number of checkpoints the tour was expected to register.

is_out_of_sequence.caption: Out Of Sequence
is_out_of_sequence.description: Indicates the checkpoint was registered outside its expected order.

geofence_status.caption: Geofence Status
geofence_status.description: Whether the reported position fell inside or outside the defined geofence at the time of the event.

position_accuracy.caption: Position Accuracy
position_accuracy.description: The horizontal accuracy of the reported position, in metres.

resource_type_id.caption: Resource Type ID
resource_type_id.description: The normalized type of response resource.

1.caption: On Site Officer
1.description: An officer already posted at the site.

2.caption: Mobile Patrol
2.description: A vehicle-based officer covering multiple sites.

3.caption: Remote Operator
3.description: A human operator in a remote monitoring centre.

4.caption: Automated Talkdown
4.description: An automated voice-down over a speaker.

8.caption: Fire Or EMS
8.description: A public fire or emergency medical service.

9.caption: Client Contact
9.description: A representative of the client organization.

resource_type.caption: Resource Type
resource_type.description: The resource type, normalized to the caption of the resource_type_id value.

assigned_time.caption: Assigned Time
assigned_time.description: The time the resource was assigned to the event.

enroute_time.caption: En Route Time
enroute_time.description: The time the resource began travelling to the location.

on_scene_time.caption: On Scene Time
on_scene_time.description: The time the resource arrived at the location.

cleared_time.caption: Cleared Time
cleared_time.description: The time the resource was released from the event.

time_to_triage.caption: Time To Triage
time_to_triage.description: The elapsed time in milliseconds from signal receipt to a disposition being assigned.

time_to_resolution.caption: Time To Resolution
time_to_resolution.description: The elapsed time in milliseconds from signal receipt to the event being closed.

validation_level_id.caption: Validation Level ID
validation_level_id.description: The alarm validation score defined by ANSI/TMA AVS-01.

1.caption: Level 0
1.description: No call for service. Response is unwarranted, as defined by ANSI/TMA AVS-01.

2.caption: Level 1
2.description: A call for service with no other information. The default level absent contributing factors.

3.caption: Level 2
3.description: A call for service with proof of, or high probability of, a person present at the site.

4.caption: Level 3
4.description: A call for service with a person present and an apparent threat to property.

5.caption: Level 4
5.description: A call for service with a person present and an apparent threat to life.

validation_level.caption: Validation Level
validation_level.description: The validation level, normalized to the caption of the validation_level_id value.

verification_method_id.caption: Verification Method ID
verification_method_id.description: The method used to verify or confirm the condition, drawing on ANSI/TMA CS-V-01.

2.caption: Phone Confirmation
2.description: A single confirmation call was placed.

3.caption: Enhanced Confirmation
3.description: Two or more investigative calls were placed, as defined by ANSI/TMA CS-V-01.

4.caption: Two Way Audio
4.description: An event-driven hands-free audio session was used.

5.caption: Listen In
5.description: A one-way audio session was used.

6.caption: Video
6.description: Recorded or live video was reviewed by a human operator.

7.caption: Analytics
7.description: An automated analytic produced the verification determination.

8.caption: Eyewitness
8.description: A person at the site confirmed the condition.

9.caption: On Site Check
9.description: A responder physically checked the location.

verification_method.caption: Verification Method
verification_method.description: The verification method, normalized to the caption of the verification_method_id value.

cause_id.caption: Cause ID
cause_id.description: The assessed cause of the signal.

1.caption: Genuine
1.description: The condition was real and correctly reported.

2.caption: User Error
2.description: An authorized person triggered the condition in error.

3.caption: Equipment Malfunction
3.description: The detection device or panel malfunctioned.

4.caption: Equipment Unsuitable
4.description: The device was inappropriate for the environment.

5.caption: Installation Fault
5.description: The device was incorrectly installed or aimed.

6.caption: Environmental
6.description: Weather, lighting, foliage, or similar environmental conditions.

8.caption: Authorized Activity
8.description: A scheduled or permitted activity triggered the condition.

9.caption: Communication Fault
9.description: A transmission or network fault produced the signal.

10.caption: Monitoring Error
10.description: The monitoring centre processed the signal incorrectly.

11.caption: Malicious
11.description: The condition was triggered deliberately and without cause.

cause.caption: Cause
cause.description: The cause, normalized to the caption of the cause_id value.

dispatch_outcome_id.caption: Dispatch Outcome ID
dispatch_outcome_id.description: What ultimately happened in response to the signal.

3.caption: Cancelled En Route
3.description: A dispatch was cancelled before arrival.

4.caption: Responded Verified
4.description: A resource arrived and confirmed the condition.

5.caption: Responded Unfounded
5.description: A resource arrived and found no condition.

6.caption: Chargeable False Alarm
6.description: The event was assessed as a chargeable false alarm under a local ordinance.

dispatch_outcome.caption: Dispatch Outcome
dispatch_outcome.description: The dispatch outcome, normalized to the caption of the dispatch_outcome_id value.

incident_type_common.caption: Common Incident Type
incident_type_common.description: The incident type drawn from the controlled vocabulary published by this extension (vocabularies/incident_type_common.json, 24 values, v0.1.0). Required so that locally defined types remain comparable across organizations.

incident_type_internal.caption: Internal Incident Type
incident_type_internal.description: The incident type as classified by the reporting organization, retained verbatim.

nibrs_offense_code.caption: NIBRS Offense Code
nibrs_offense_code.description: The offense code from the National Incident-Based Reporting System, where the incident describes a criminal act.

apco_incident_type.caption: APCO Incident Type
apco_incident_type.description: The common incident type code used for public safety data exchange, where the incident was referred for dispatch.

narrative.caption: Narrative
narrative.description: The free-text account of the incident recorded by the reporting person.

is_reportable.caption: Reportable
is_reportable.description: Indicates the incident meets a client or regulatory reporting threshold.

loss_amount.caption: Loss Amount
loss_amount.description: The estimated financial loss associated with the incident, in the smallest unit of the reporting currency.

site_uid.caption: Site UID
site_uid.description: The unique identifier of the physical site.

site_name.caption: Site Name
site_name.description: The name of the physical site.

floor.caption: Floor
floor.description: The floor or level within the building.
